question: What source-bound first-fall certificates and degree-two closure LFD bounds or exact values are obtained for every generated N83 candidate factor-base PDP presentation across coordinate bits 27..39?

claims.text: For each of 624 candidate PDP systems, report the first-fall certificate or explicit unresolved outcome; for each binary/Koblitz system, report degree-two closure LFD only when an admissible global upper certificate verifies, otherwise retain a bound or unresolved status.
First fall and last fall are not the top-form degree of regularity, solving degree, universal heuristic, or ECDLP recovery result. The companion top-form Dreg panel is frozen separately.
Coordinate-bit comparisons are finite-panel exact comparisons only; no factor-base ranking is promoted until the candidate-held-out model protocol passes.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact computations only; no clock or statistical comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Existing exact native controls verify planted equations, membership and replay; each planted case carries an explicit witness checked by pdp generation.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Existing tampered replay and nonlinear-control tests reject invalid certificates; all failures remain retained.

factors.name: source_and_binaries
factors.how: pdp, fall and compare source/binary hashes pinned per arm.

factors.name: coordinate_bit
factors.how: All13 complete fixed coordinate domains r=27..39; no omitted bit.

factors.name: family
factors.how: All three curve families; prime degree-two closure marked unsupported.

factors.name: target_kind
factors.how: Shared deterministic planted tuple and original natural targets across candidate coordinate bits.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Record host, kernel, Spot identity and memory; no timing comparison.

factors.name: budgets
factors.how: Per-case cap for first-fall and binary closure; preserve timeouts and incomplete cases.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Ascending bit, family, m and target kind; deterministic.

comparisons.threshold: Accept exact per-input certificate only after completion and successful replay; unsupported and failed values remain null.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exhaustive deterministic cases; no timing or population comparison.

seed_derivation.note: SplitMix family/m rule in frozen pdp source; planted tuple uses common low-26 support.

instance_sampling.rule: All624 candidate presentations; 416 binary closure attempts; 208 prime closures are explicitly unsupported.

power.note: 624 fixed presentations in an exhaustive finite panel; no inferential population test.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: One-day cap includes bounded first-fall and binary closure attempts plus replay; not a runtime estimate.

primary.name: Certified first-fall lower bound
primary.definition: Per-input lower bound from exact first-fall procedure; a cap or timeout contributes no extra degree bound.

primary.name: Degree-two closure LFD interval or exact value
primary.definition: LFD exact only with explicit lower witness and admissible global upper certificate; otherwise keep separate lower and upper bounds or null.

secondary.name: Exact first-fall degree when certified
secondary.definition: First exact nonzero degree fall if established; otherwise null.

secondary.name: Degree-two closure rank
secondary.definition: Completed Boolean V2 normal-form closure rank; a plateau is not a global LFD upper.

secondary.name: Closure status
secondary.definition: Exact, bounded, resource_limit, error, unsupported or incomplete per native replay.

checkpoint.restore_validation: verify SHA-256 then fresh-process replay; retain original failed attempt and use fresh prefix for infrastructure retry

stopping_rules.rule: Run first-fall for all624 cases; run degree-two closure for all416 Koblitz/general-binary cases; preserve 208 prime closure cases as explicitly unsupported; replay every completed certificate and retain all partial/error rows.
Maximum60 seconds per first-fall/closure case, one thread,8GiB,86400-second outer cap; interruption produces a preserved partial export and fresh-attempt key only.

invalidation_rules: Hash mismatch, malformed input or failed replay invalidates a certificate
Closure plateau alone does not certify last fall degree
Resource limits imply no mathematical degree bound
Every elapsed time is diagnostic, wall_valid=false

decision_rule.text: Report per-input certificate values, intervals and unresolved outcomes. Exact LFD requires the original admissible global upper certificate; do not infer it from closure plateau.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Matched exact degree differences only for same family,m,target kind

inputs: candidate input indices and system.sing sources produced under protocol-top-factorbase-v1.json
outputs: 624 first-fall case rows and fresh replays
416 binary closure case rows and fresh replays

graphs: Paired FFD/LFD and closure-rank grid, unknowns explicit

inadmissible: Reporting final basis degree as solving degree
Using timeout as a degree bound
Downscaling n or omitting m cells
Claiming an IC/rho speedup or subgroup attack from this stage
Equating closure plateau with global stabilization
Inferring lower regularity or elite factor-base quality from low FFD/LFD alone
